decisions.reason: The drink mix builds on the firm's nutrient and food-related knowledge and its in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it, though it is less core than the waste-to-energy products.
It is a modular extension of the firm's established waste-to-energy technology, directly leveraging core related knowledge and R&D.
Waste oil to energy is closely related to existing waste-to-energy knowledge and was launched with dedicated communication, enabling learning and improvement.
Plastic waste to fuel is close to the firm's established offer and supported by in-house R&D, so related knowledge can be assimilated and applied.
